findings.location: Main PDF page 22, Remark 4.4, first sentence
findings.claim: After adding one tube to each genus-one one-boundary surface, the resulting surfaces are called genus one.
findings.decisive_evidence: chi_before=-1; removing two disks and gluing an annulus gives chi_after=-3 with one boundary, hence genus 2. Exact independent Euler calculation succeeds. Official v3 HTML has the same wording.
findings.impact: Local genus statement is false. The stabilization-distance-one claim is compatible with the corrected genus and is not refuted.
findings.repair: Replace genus-1 by genus-2. Figure 19 has now actually been inspected; its band movie is consistent with stabilization distance one.
findings.counterexample_hypotheses: Uses precisely the genus-one surfaces, one boundary component, and single interior tube stipulated in Remark 4.4.

independent_verification.original_claim: Remark 4.4 calls the surfaces obtained by adding one interior tube to the genus-one surfaces genus one.
evidence_locations: Main PDF p.22, Remark 4.4 first sentence and final two sentences; actual enlarged page observed
Main pp.2 and 4 identify the original genus-one surfaces
Main p.23, Figure 19 and caption, actually observed
independent_verification.assumptions: Connected orientable genus-one surfaces with exactly one boundary component, and a single interior tube on each, exactly as stipulated. The boundary count is unchanged.
independent_verification.independent_proof: For each original surface chi=2-2g-b=2-2-1=-1. Removing two interior open disks reduces chi by 2; gluing an annulus along circles changes chi by 0. Therefore chi_new=-3 and -3=2-2g_new-1 gives g_new=2. This uses the operation actually stated, rather than a speculative interpretation of a diagram. Current exact rational arithmetic confirms the Euler calculation.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Figure 19 and its caption are compatible with a band isotopy after one stabilization; band endpoints may slide on the surgered link, after which the other three bands are restored. This does not make the printed genus-one value correct, and does not contradict stabilization distance one.
independent_verification.impact: The local genus statement is false. The correction does not refute the main topological or smooth nonisotopy theorems and does not change the number of stabilizations asserted.
independent_verification.repair: Replace genus-1 by genus-2 in the first sentence of Remark 4.4.
independent_verification.repair_limits: This local correction settles the identified genus error only. It is not a new proof of every diagrammatic or gauge-theoretic part of the paper.

honest_scope_check.result: Current report preserves distinctions between established local facts and unreproduced dependencies.
honest_scope_check.independent_algebra: For both printed Seifert matrices, det(V-t V^T)=6t^2-11t+6. Their symmetrizations have determinant 23. For q=6m^2+5mn+2n^2, 8q=(4n+5m)^2+23m^2. If q=1 then m=0 and 2n^2=1 is impossible; q=-1 is excluded by nonnegativity. Thus Q0 represents neither sign of 2, while Q1 represents -2 at (0,1). The analogous nonorientable identity 12(12m^2+10mn+3n^2)=(6n+10m)^2+44m^2 excludes both signs of 1. These universal statements follow analytically, not from a finite search. Geometry outside the observed pages remains attributed to the initial review.
honest_scope_check.supplement: All five pages, including Figures A-C and every displayed command, were read and actually observed. Proposition A.1 uses the computed genus-three base case, not only the pictured upper bound. Section B includes verified=True calls for short slopes and canonical retriangulation but ordinary displayed length-spectrum and cusp-area calls. The finite loop invokes verify_hyperbolicity without displaying a complete versioned interval transcript. No author command was executed.
honest_scope_check.conditional_threshold: Using the printed cusp area 18.86, 46^2-(10.1)^2*18.86=960457/5000>0, so 46/sqrt(18.86)>10.1. This exact arithmetic does not certify the underlying geometric computation.
honest_scope_check.gauge_scope: Main pp.30-31 and the final report's limitations were read. A scalar Morgan-Mrowka-Szabo sum does not by itself reconstruct individual basic-class support or all boundary markings. Those dependencies remain explicitly unrebuilt; no counterexample is asserted on that basis.
